g.text: Tools: Git, PlantUML tested, LibGDX chosen
Initial risk assessment for client meeting
GameTimer: 5 min countdown, game ends when time runs out
Pause and resume (Esc), game starts paused
Goose spawning until time runs out: max 15
Event 2 - BossGoose: arrives at 60s with flock
Random item spawns: 75% energy drink / 25% megaphone (A2)
Event 1 - Hidden puddles: invisible until stepped on, slow player
Puddles also slow geese, more puddles
Speed modifiers: touching geese slows player, energy drink, puddles
HUD: lives, time remaining, items and events
Expanded world bounds, geese spawn just off camera
Package final JAR, test on lab machines
